findings.issue: בְגַפּוֹ is preposition ב plus גַּף (H1610) ‘body/self’ plus his: with/in his body, by himself. «soledad» replaces that noun with solitude/loneliness.
תִּהְיֶה is qal imperfect 3fs singular. «serán» is plural, smoothing agreement to the compound subject without changing who belongs to the master.

notes: Singular «señor» follows יִתֶּן 3ms; the plural shape of אדון is formal.
